translation:
If one uses attacking and reducing methods, then the deficient become more deficient and the stagnant become more stagnant, and disaster will follow at once. <ins>Dang Gui Stagnation-Guiding Powder (當歸導滯散)</ins>
Sichuan rhubarb (川大黃, one liang), dang gui (當歸, two and a half qian), musk (麝香, a little)
Above, three ingredients; except for the musk, which is ground separately, grind into extremely fine powder, then add the musk and mix evenly; take three qian per dose, mixed with one cup of hot wine. <ins>Another formula (又方)</ins>
Sichuan rhubarb (川大黃), dang gui (當歸, each two liang)
Above, grind all together into fine powder; take three qian per dose, without regard to time, mixed with warm wine.
